name: phases intro
content: Below are the services provided at each Phase of the project. We are always happy to go over these services with you to answer any questions and assist with selecting the best options for your project.

name: construction administration (CA) - standard
content:
construction administration (CA)

Once you have selected a Contractor and start building, ZINN remains involved to ensure the quality of the work and to help clarify the design intent.

Deliverables: construction kick-off meeting, submittal review, shop drawing review, payment application review, change order review, contractor RFIs, rough-in site walkthrough, punch list walkthrough, progress review meetings (hourly as requested)

name: construction documents (CD) - standard
content:
construction documents (CD)

During CDs, we supplement all the work that has been done to date with all the final information that a contractor will require to build the project and that the permitting officials will require to issue a permit.

Deliverables: signed and sealed permit/construction drawings, construction details, permit official responses/revisions, bidder requests for information, engineering solicitation (Civil, Mechanical, Plumbing, Electrical, Structural, Fire-Protection, PEMB), engineering coordination

name: design development (DD) - standard
content:
design development (DD)

Once you approve a schematic direction, we begin working on the details and specifics to more fully describe the design and identify the technical challenges to achieving it.

Deliverables: Fixture and Finish schedule development (dd1 concepts, dd2 selections, dd3 cabinetry and woodwork, dd4 samples), dd5 outside meetings (plumbing fixtures/bath accessories, doors and windows, millworker review, ceiling plan review)

name: schematic design (SD) - standard
content:
schematic design (SD)

During SD, we begin to put pen to paper to create loose floor plans in an effort to capture the goals of the project formally. Drawings are of a moderate level of detail to accurately vet various approaches while leaving some specifics and details for later development.

Deliverables: scaled and annotated floor plans, massing studies, 3d views (sketchy style), review meetings/video conferences (SD1, SD2, SDF)

name: pre design (PD) - standard
content:
pre design (PD)

This phase involves preliminary efforts to accurately document existing conditions on-site and estimate potential costs.

Deliverables: in-person site visit or consult credit, existing conditions survey/laser scan and to-scale existing floor plans (as needed), diagrammatic renovation or construction scenarios, in-person or video conf draft review, area categories and square foot cost analysis

name: hourly no budget
content:
hourly no budget

If your project is 'hourly no budget,' work is completed on an hourly basis based on the rates indicated in the 'Hourly Work' section below. Work continues as long as the Client requests services/deliverables or engages ZINN in project correspondence. An estimate of how long a particular task may take can be provided on request.

name: fixed fee
content:
fixed fee

For fixed fee projects, ZINN uses a simple and predictable monthly payment schedule to allow our clients to amortize the cost of architectural services. Upon acceptance, you will be prompted for the first payment. Typically we break the fee into 5 payments of 20% each unless the project is unusually large or unusually small (less than $10k).

Fee Adjustment: At the completion of each Phase, ZINN will review the project development and may propose an adjustment to the fee if the project has deviated from the Scope of Work outlined here.

Pausing or Stopping Work: If you decide to pause your project we will hold off on monthly invoicing until you authorize us to proceed or period of 6 months has transpired.

name: not-to-exceed
content:
not-to-exceed

If your project stipulates a not-to-exceed (NTE) estimate, work will be billed hourly based on the rates noted in the 'Hourly Work' section below. An email notice will be sent to the Client should the accrued fees equal the NTE amount stipulated in the Proposed Fee section above. Work will continue and hourly fees will continue to accrue in excess of the stipulated NTE until the work is complete, the Client halts work on the project, or the Client stipulates a higher NTE amount.

name: furnishings and decor - ask us
content:
furnishings and decor

Ask us about Furnishing and Decor services! We can help you fill out your project down to the finest detail. We utilize our vendor relationships to ensure the highest quality furnishings and accessories are selected and even offer installation/staging services.

Services: prepare and present design boards, prepare purchase orders and place orders upon client approval, track orders and update delivery schedule, oversee storage/delivery/installation of furnishings, decorative/furniture specifications.

name: furnishings and decor (FD) - service levels
content:
furnishings and decor (FD)

The finishing touches that really bring a project together. We propose sofas, rugs, side tables, lamps, and other such items that are not 'attached' to the building. Available at Basic, Standard, and Premium service levels.

name: how we work / about ZINN
content:
ZINN designs spaces to elevate the everyday experiences of their occupants. Our projects are not only functional, but work well on many intersecting levels, from aesthetics to psychology to waterproofing to creativity. Through a process-oriented approach, we focus on our clients' experiences rather than just the walls that shelter them. At ZINN, we strive to frame everyday movement/activities in their most beautiful and humane light.

Values: Careful / Diligent / Deliberate, Creative, Probing, Curious, Experiential, Caring

Services: Interior design, Interiors purchasing/Logistics/Staging, 3d Visualizations/Renderings, Site design/Master Planning, Concept/Schematic Design, Construction Administration, Feasibility/Civic/Approvals/Code Review, Life Safety Plans, Expert Witness
